scope: Exactly three navigation test files run once on fresh detached current main. No game/browser/AI benchmark or source/test edits.

interpretation.attribution: Four navigation failures reproduce on current main; shared source tree, tested files and captured configuration match PR386e530. They are not introduced by this client-art PR.
behavior: Recovery reference has 2 points instead of expected 1; that precondition stops the later movement checks.
One of six ships has not fired in the fixed observation window; this is an observable gameplay-quality assertion.
Cruise first-segment forward projection is 0 rather than positive; no conclusion about completed berth motion follows from this failed assertion alone.
Not every zero-margin route point carries exact=true; this fails route-control metadata expectations.
interpretation.testVsImplementation: The run establishes failure and PR attribution, not whether each navigation requirement or implementation should change. Do not classify all four as faulty tests or relax assertions without a separate navigation investigation.
